title: sedum rosea subsp. integrifolium
intro: Sedum rosea subsp. integrifolium, commonly known as White Stonecrop, is a type of succulent plant belonging to the Crassulaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including providing relief from various health issues such as wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory problems, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The health benefits of Sedum rosea subsp. integrifolium include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as wound healing, skin protection, and anti-aging. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
